test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Substitute one word for the italicised expression.**

Shelley was also known for his association with John Keats and Lord Byron as these were __*the men living in the same age*__.
solution:
Here the correct answer is** contemporaries.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"contemporaries"** means **people who lived during the same time period.** In this sentence, Shelley is known for his association with John Keats and Lord Byron because they all lived during the same time period. 

 
 
• Example: Shakespeare and Christopher Marlowe were **contemporaries **in the Elizabethan era.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other options:**
 
• **Preceding**: This means coming before in time or order. It is not the correct answer in this sentence because Shelley's association with Keats and Byron was not about them coming before him in time or order. 
 
 
• Example: The **preceding **chapter in the book discussed the history of the city.
 
 
 
• **Old-fashioned: **This means out of date or no longer in fashion. It is not the correct answer in this sentence because it does not accurately describe Shelley's association with Keats and Byron. 
 
 
• Example: My grandmother's taste in clothing is very** old-fashioned.**
 
 
 
• **Succeeding: **This means coming after in time or order. It is not the correct answer in this sentence because Shelley's association with Keats and Byron was not about them coming after him in time or order. 
 
 
• Example: The **succeeding **chapter in the book will discuss the author's personal experiences.
 
 
 
• Overall,** "contemporaries" **is the best word to use in this sentence because it accurately describes the relationship between Shelley, Keats, and Byron as people who lived during the same time period.
